parsed_output.embedding_text: In this 16-second fitness TikTok, creator @sebastianburka shares a pivotal tip for 'reshaping the axial skeleton brick by brick.' The video features him speaking from his car and demonstrating an exercise on an Atlantis chest fly machine in a gym setting. He is seen wearing a grey tank top and a New York Yankees baseball cap. The core advice provided through on-screen text is to 'stop arching' and 'stop retracting' during movements, instead focusing on 'expansion' to achieve better structural results. This content is aimed at gym-goers looking for technical lifting advice to improve their posture and muscle engagement. The video is set to the track 'Phonky Tribu' and serves as a concise tutorial on optimizing chest training form for structural body changes.
